EXHIBITION AGREEMENT between North Gallery (233 Race Street, Philadelphia, PA 19106) and Sofia Alvarez.
Signed by Sofia Alvarez on October 30, 2026 and countersigned by Renee Okafor for North Gallery on November 1, 2026.

1. Exhibition. 'Night Shift: The River Wards After Dark', project room, December 4-27, 2026. Opening reception on First Friday, December 4, 5-9 pm.
2. Works. Eight framed archival pigment prints chosen by the artist with the curator. Drop-off Monday, November 30, 10:00-14:00, and pick-up Monday, December 28, 10:00-14:00, both at the rear door on Bread Street.
3. Sales. The artist sets the retail prices. The gallery's commission is 30% of the retail price. The gallery collects and remits sales tax and pays the artist's share within ten days after the exhibition closes.
4. Copyright and images. The artist keeps the copyright and all originals, master files and print files. The gallery may reproduce up to three images of works in the exhibition, each approved by the artist, at no more than 1920 px on the long edge, on the gallery's website, newsletter and social media accounts, only to promote this exhibition, with the credit line '© 2026 Sofia Alvarez'. An image showing an identifiable person may be used only if the artist holds a signed model release from that person. Any other use, sale of reproductions or transfer of images to third parties needs the artist's written consent; press requests are referred to the artist.
5. Insurance. The gallery insures the works while on its premises at the retail price less commission.
6. Costs. The artist pays printing, framing and transport. The gallery pays the reception, the announcement and its design.

PRINT SPECIFICATION - signed by Sofia Alvarez and Marco Diaz (Print Room), October 28, 2026
Quantity: eight prints, one of each selected work.
Paper: cotton rag matte, 300 gsm.
Sheet: 13 x 19 in. Image: 11 x 16.5 in, centred, with a white border.
Full frame: the image is printed as delivered, no crop and no resizing beyond fitting the image area.
Files: 16-bit TIFF, 300 ppi at print size, embedded colour profile, supplied by the artist.
Test print: one image at the same spec before the run, $39.
Price: $39 per print, eight prints $312. Turnaround: three business days from payment.

ARTIST STATEMENT - DRAFT 1 (Oct 15, 228 words, too long)

I started photographing at night by accident. In 2024, after a double shift, I walked home along Front Street and saw the sanitation crew working under a single lamp... [long paragraph about the alternates, the darkroom group, and the corner store cat; Renee asked for 150 words maximum]

Night Shift: The River Wards After Dark

For two years I photographed Fishtown, Kensington and Port Richmond between midnight and sunrise, mostly on my way home from twelve-hour shifts at the hospital. At that hour the neighbourhood belongs to people whose work keeps the day running: bakers, drivers, nurses, the ice truck and the bus that never quite empties. I work with available light only, from sodium lamps, laundromat fluorescents and the river's reflections, and I print full frame. These eight pictures are not about loneliness. They are about the company you find when most of the city is asleep.

Sofia Alvarez lives and works in Philadelphia. This is her first solo exhibition.

Renee
